title: College of Winterhold
description: Skyrim's mages' guild: the Saarthal excavation, the Eye of Magnus and the road to Arch-Mage.

items.title: Visit the College of Winterhold
items.description: Travel to the College in Winterhold and pass Faralda's entrance test on the bridge.
tips: The test is to cast a particular spell; Faralda can sell it to you on the spot. Nords can talk their way in instead.

items.title: First Lessons
items.description: A tour of the College with Mirabelle Ervine and Tolfdir's first lesson on wards.

items.title: Under Saarthal
items.description: Excavate the ancient city of Saarthal: find the Saarthal Amulet, meet the Psijic Nerien and discover the mysterious Eye of Magnus.
tips: You keep the Saarthal Amulet, and it gives useful magic bonuses.

items.title: Hitting the Books
items.description: Urag gro-Shub needs books about the Eye, but former student Orthorn stole them. Recover the books from Fellglow Keep.
tips: You can save Orthorn or leave him — it doesn't affect the reward.

items.title: Good Intentions
items.description: The Psijic Quaranir warns you about the danger of the Eye and advises you to speak with the Augur of Dunlain deep beneath the College.

items.title: Revealing the Unseen
items.description: Find Paratus Decimius in the Dwemer ruin of Mzulft and use the Focusing Crystal to activate the Oculory and learn about the Staff of Magnus.

items.title: Containment
items.description: Ancano seals himself in the Hall of the Elements with the Eye, and magical anomalies roam the town. Deal with them and find out where to look for the Staff.
items.missable: Savos Aren dies during this quest — his tasks and dialogue are gone for good.

items.title: The Staff of Magnus
items.description: Make your way through Labyrinthian and take the Staff of Magnus from the dragon priest Morokei.
tips: Morokei drains magicka — rely on potions and weapons, not spells.
Morokei drops his dragon priest mask.

items.title: The Eye of Magnus
items.description: Stop Ancano with the Staff of Magnus and save the College. Afterwards you become Arch-Mage.
tips: The Archmage's Robes are in the Arch-Mage's Quarters, along with an alchemy lab and an arcane enchanter.

items.title: Brelyna's Practice
items.description: Help Brelyna Maryon practice her spells — you're the test subject, with funny results.
tips: Afterwards Brelyna can become a follower.

items.title: Onmund's Request
items.description: Get back the family amulet Onmund gave to Enthir.
tips: Afterwards Onmund can become a follower.

items.title: J'zargo's Experiment
items.description: Test J'zargo's Flame Cloak scrolls in combat against the undead.
tips: Afterwards J'zargo can become a follower.

items.title: Arniel's Endeavor
items.description: A four-part chain: help Arniel Gane research the disappearance of the Dwemer.
items.missable: At the end Arniel vanishes for good — sharing the fate of the Dwemer.

items.title: Rejoining the College
items.description: If you're expelled from the College (for example, for attacking its members), pay a fine to get back in.

items.title: Out of Balance
items.description: Cleanse the magical focal points around the College. Reward: soul gems and a temporary boost to magicka regeneration.

items.title: Enchanting Pick-Up
items.description: Collect an item from one of Sergius's clients that needs enchanting.

items.title: Restocking Soul Gems
items.description: Help Sergius restock his soul gems. Reward: gold.

items.title: Aftershock
items.description: Close a rift left behind by the Eye of Magnus.

items.title: Tolfdir the Absent-Minded
items.location: College of Winterhold, Hall of Countenance
items.description: Tolfdir has lost something again — find it. Reward: 30 septims and an empty soul gem.

items.title: Fetch me that Book!
items.description: Find a book in a dungeon for Urag. Reward: a little gold.

items.title: Shalidor's Insights
items.description: Find Shalidor's writings for Urag. Reward: three "Shalidor's Insights" scrolls or a magic skill boost.
tips: A scroll makes spells of one school cheaper for a while — handy before a tough fight.

items.title: Alteration Ritual Spell
items.description: The master ritual of the Alteration school. Reward: the Dragonhide spell.

items.title: Conjuration Ritual Spell
items.description: The master ritual of the Conjuration school. Reward: Thrall summoning spells.

items.title: Destruction Ritual Spell
items.description: The master ritual of the Destruction school. Reward: access to master spell tomes.

items.title: Illusion Ritual Spell
items.location: College of Winterhold: the Arcanaeum, Hall of Countenance, Hall of Attainment, the Midden
items.description: The master ritual of the Illusion school: move through the College unseen under the effects of spells. Reward: master Illusion spells.

items.title: Restoration Ritual Spell
items.description: The master ritual of the Restoration school. Reward: master Restoration spells.
